title: Pointer-selected tooltip
intent: Emphasize and reveal an Apple closing-price observation on pointer proximity while keeping the chart keyboard-focusable and the original AAPL fields intact.

source.title: Observable Plot tip and pointer interaction

ai.create: Create a UTC line chart from the AAPL dataset's Date and Close fields whose nearest point reveals the formatted Apple closing price.
ai.maintain: Make the tooltip sticky on selection while keeping the raw stock observations, pointer, keyboard, and update behavior aligned.
